content:
This is a followup to #Project announcements > Lean implementation of Markdown

@Alfredo Moreira-Rosa I did consider using parser combinators for the above, but decided not to do so because the highly contextual nature of the Markdown specification means that I would end up threading state by hand no matter what. Markdown's structure depends on state accumulated elsewhere in the document, an open-block stack for lines, a delimiter stack for emphasis, forward-referenced link definitions, rather than on what's directly ahead of the cursor, so the "look at what's next and recurse" style combinators are built for doesn't capture much of it.

But I'd be delighted to hear if I've missed anything?
